title: DojoLiq Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid by Vaporesso
description: Vaporesso DojoLiq Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Ice is a powerhouse red berry medley. The profile layers the mellow sweetness of Strawberry, the sharp tang of Raspberry, and the deep, dark richness of Cherry into one incredibly robust fruit vape. A refreshing icy kick on the exhale ties the three distinct berries together, adding a crispness that keeps the flavour bright and engaging. To ensure peak performance, this Nicotine Salt e-liquid features a finely tuned 45% VG / 55% PG ratio specifically optimised for this blend. This bespoke formulation guarantees rapid wicking and maximum flavour transmission when used with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) pod systems and starter vape kits. The Nicotine Salt blend ensures a gentle throat feel and fast-acting nicotine relief. Brought to you by the hardware specialists at Vaporesso, the DojoLiq collection captures the vibrant, authentic flavours of their popular Dojo series in a versatile 10ml format. Available in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg strengths, these e-liquids offer rapid nicotine satisfaction and consistently bold taste from the first drop to the last.
